sql: SELECT COALESCE(r.location_id, 0) AS location_id, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t > '2024-11-24T18:00' THEN CAST(r.hourly.precipitation[i] AS DOUBLE) END), 1) AS rain_past_24h_mm, ROUND(SUM(CAST(r.hourly.precipitation[i] AS DOUBLE)), 1) AS rain_past_7d_mm, MAX(t) AS last_hour FROM veda_wx.om_rain_nov2024 r LATERAL VIEW posexplode(r.hourly.time) h AS i, t WHERE t > '2024-11-18T18:00' AND t <= '2024-11-25T18:00' GROUP BY COALESCE(r.location_id, 0)
